core_obligations: Identify the fibre over a prime with the base change to the residue field and describe its primes (proof lines 12884-12890).

For a prime in that fibre, choose a maximal ideal containing it and compute the localisation of the fibre as the localisation of the fibre over the corresponding maximal ideal (proof lines 12890-12897).
Use property (B) to conclude that the three conditions of the statement are equivalent (proof lines 12897-12901).
proof_roadmap: Describe the fibre and its primes (proof lines 12884-12890).
Reduce to maximal ideals by the localisation computation (proof lines 12890-12897).
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a homomorphism of Noetherian rings, a property P of the fibres that can be checked on local rings may be tested after localising at any prime or even only at maximal ideals, and the proof is an 18-line argument built on the identification of the fibre over a prime with the localisation of the target. It relates the fibre over a prime to the fibre over a maximal ideal containing it by a base change computation, and then invokes the hypothesis that P is a local property of rings to pass between the localisations. The base change computation is the substance, and it is displayed explicitly.
